task.details:
Proposed goal: the storefront can consume app-shell engine packages (Tailwind v4, Next seams proven by a rendered product-grid) and every later wave is measurable (registry with propsUsed, golden baseline, token map). Proposed acceptance: (1) stage exists; dev pushed once q-store-remote is answered; (2) Docker Playwright summary + vitest run copied; (3) specs/design-system/ui-inventory.json valid, totals equal 00-program section 2, propsUsed rollup present; (4) golden baseline on v3 for 16 exports + 30 icons recorded; (5) after Tailwind v4: golden equal within tolerance and toHaveScreenshot green on every matrix page, counts copied; preset compatibility finding in docs/design-system/tailwind-v4-migration.md with command outputs; (6) specs/design-system/token-map.json with 26 rows and usageCount; (7) product-grid rendered from @ivanprotsko-org/renderer + block-gen on live products, screenshot + seams list; engine-side needs written to artifacts/deliverables/app-shell-requests/.

T0a+T0b 5c4c6d2 (orchestrator A, worktree feat/ds-foundation from dev@ed335b8): stage branch created from dev, dev NOT pushed (q-store-remote open, origin is the public gorgojs fork). Toolchain verified on this machine before any agent prompt (25i): corepack pnpm 10.11.1 is mandatory (bare pnpm on PATH is 8.12.0, refuses lockfile v9); Playwright 1.63.0 + image v1.63.0-noble -> "corepack pnpm ui-lab:test" printed "2 passed (5.1s)"; container reaches host.docker.internal:9022/health 200 and :8000/en 200; vitest 4.1.11 -> "No test files found" exit 0 (pinned to 4.1.11 not 5.0.0 because 5.0.0 needs @types/node ^22 and the workspace is on ^20.19.0); npx tsc --noEmit exit 0, next lint clean; GitHub Packages readable, renderer 1.0.3 / block-gen 1.2.1 (note: "set -a; . ~/upready/.env.keys" yields an EMPTY token, the working form is grep -m1 + cut). Confirmed known risk: @medusajs/ui 4.2.1 peer react ^18.3.1 vs installed react 19.0.5, reproduced by this install. package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml are orchestrator-only for this task so parallel agents cannot collide on them. Step 0 remainder is running as workflow wf_1ff5aaa5-c9b: registry (Sonnet) + Next smoke (Opus) in parallel, then ui-lab harness/v3 baseline (Opus) + token map (Sonnet), then Tailwind v4 (Opus), then an adversarial verifier (Opus); agent reports land as JSON in artifacts/docs/step0/ and only thin envelopes come back (25h). Open: q-ds-inventory-rollup-schema (totals.additionalProperties is false, so the propsUsed rollup needs a schema bump; written to a sidecar file meanwhile).

ARCHITECT ANSWER to q-ds-inventory-rollup-schema (2026-09-06, closed): bump upready.ui-inventory/v0 IN PLACE, no v1 — the registry does not exist yet, so there is no consumer to break. totals.propsUsedByComponent is now a REQUIRED property of totals: key = the SAME "<package>:<Component>" string as totals.byComponent (so the two objects join on one key), value = prop name -> number of call sites writing that prop, spreads counted under "<spread>". Schema-valid therefore MEANS rollup-present, one gate instead of two. The sidecar specs/design-system/ui-inventory-props-rollup.json is CANCELLED: the rollup lives inside specs/design-system/ui-inventory.json, do not commit the sidecar. Per-entry props stay as they are ($defs.entry.props already holds the literal props of each call site).

2026-09-06 08:4x architect (revision 3, 00-program §12): Ivan's goal of the day folded in as T0h presets → T0i hidden panel → T0j four product-card variants → T0k image treatments; T0e Tailwind v4 moves after the day's goal unless already green. Acceptance icons count 30→33 per the TS-parser registry (t0c-ui-inventory.json). Merge of T0b into dev = 0cb4a36 (second architect session, accepted).

2026-09-06 16:5x session store-ds-5 (solo, no agents). Rescued the orchestrator output from feat/ds-foundation and rebased it onto dev@552de62 — 6 commits, dev-only 0 / branch-only 6. T0c dc439f6, T0f a0e5a67 + fix 7c1a2d7, T0d 096f7f9, T0g a0ac356, T0e note 1afb627. Every gate re-run by me, nothing copied from the worker reports: tsc exit 0; next lint clean; next build exit 0 with both ui-lab routes emitted at 158 B/103 kB and 15 kB/169 kB; corepack pnpm ui-lab:test in docker = 19 passed (1.2m), 353 case-viewports, 0 dimensions differ; apps/ui-smoke tsc 0, build 0, ui-smoke:test = 1 passed (4.6s) against the shared backend on 9022. Three defects fixed while committing, all measured first: (1) T0c never applied the architect answer to q-ds-inventory-rollup-schema, so the rollup went into totals.propsUsedByComponent and the cancelled sidecar is not committed (dev already carried the schema bump as b8b6d40 — resolved in favour of the architect version during the rebase); (2) token-map.json had two damaged cells, rows[0] ui-fg-base with no status and rows[1] ui-fg-subtle with usageCount as the string a-lot, both repaired from my own re-measurement which reproduces the whole report exactly; (3) T0d had its tailwind.config.js edit overwritten by the T0e migration, so the three globs hint, select and src/ui-lab are restored in v3 form. T0e Tailwind v4 is NOT committed as code: package.json still declares tailwindcss ^3.0.23, the storefront importer of the lockfile was never touched, and v4 reached the app only as symlinks written straight into apps/storefront/node_modules at 09:09 — it does not survive pnpm install. The five-file diff and the reason are in artifacts/docs/step0/t0e-tailwind-v4-not-accepted.patch and t0e-tailwind-v4-status.md. NOT pushed and NOT merged into dev.
